scope: Written deductions with published inputs; no claim of originality, external review, or formal verification.
not_verified_by_finite_checks: certificate networks inside a Burnside Bernoulli action
critical_assumptions: Networks and paths fixed before auxiliary atom selection.
Every macroedge is an actual finite path in S plus a-edges.
Load constraints are on distinct underlying selected points, not nominal edge names.
The weighted minimum cut is GLOBAL, not only an s-t cut.
L counts required new a-edges per macroedge, not full end-to-end path length.
The corridor is a benchmark, not a constructed Burnside quotient.
Near-cost-one seeds alone do not bound ambient action cost.
No earlier broad bounded-exponent or two-generator result is assumed.
